intro: Max is a cellist, guitarist and composer writing for theatre and releasing original work. Performances range from folk venues to pit orchestras, always with an ear for the space between sound and story.
awardsText: Max's work has been recognised with an OffCommendation - Best Supporting Performance for Sebastian in Twelfth Night at the Union Theatre, cited for 'a performance of quiet, luminous control', and a Soundtrack of the Year nomination from the Independent Music Theatre Awards for the original score to The Long Shore.
